items.headline: Brazil Advances to Round of 16
items.body: Brazil secured a dramatic 2-1 victory over Japan in the Round of 32, with Gabriel Martinelli scoring a 95th-minute winner. This hard-fought win propelled them into the next stage of the tournament.

items.headline: Group C Winners
items.body: Brazil topped Group C with 7 points and a +6 goal difference, finishing ahead of Morocco. Their group stage included a draw against Morocco and a dominant win over Haiti.

items.headline: Round of 16 Clash Against Norway
items.body: Brazil is set to face Norway in the Round of 16 on Sunday, July 5, 2026. The match will take place at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey.

metadata.venue: MetLife Stadium, East Rutherford, New Jersey

items.headline: Paquetá Out for Tournament
items.body: Midfielder Lucas Paquetá suffered a grade-two hamstring injury against Japan and is expected to miss the remainder of the World Cup. This is a significant blow to Brazil's midfield depth.

items.headline: Neymar Returns to Training
items.body: Neymar has returned to full tactical training after recovering from a pre-tournament calf strain. He is now fit and available for selection, potentially offering a significant boost for the knockout stages.

items.headline: Ancelotti's Midfield Dilemma
items.body: Coach Carlo Ancelotti faces a challenge in midfield following Paquetá's injury, as he was a key creative link. Ancelotti may consider alternatives like Danilo Santos or a more attacking setup with additional forwards.
